title: Slash pricing
description: A left-aligned serif heading with an italic first word over a full hairline, then two open plan columns with no boxes: plan name, a big 48px price with a grey period, a grey line, a full-width pill button (hairline for the free plan, solid white for the featured one) and a list of thin ticks with dimmer prices after a dash; the featured plan's ticks are gold.
notes: a 960px column, narrower than the page, as the original
